rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice for replacing or swapping one thing for another.

example.english: I want to exchange it for a bigger coat.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 wun6 gin6 daai6 di1 ge3 ngoi6 tou3

rows.note: Use this for the act or result of swapping things, rights, or information rather than a commercial transaction.

example.english: The exchange of phone numbers made it easier for us to keep in touch.
example.traditional: 我哋交換咗電話號碼，方便之後聯絡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gaau1 wun6 zo2 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 fong1 bin6 zi1 hau6 lyun4 lok3

rows.note: Use this for an exchange understood as a trade or commercial transaction.

example.english: Both sides think this exchange is fair.
example.traditional: 呢單交易雙方都覺得公平。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 gaau1 jik6 soeng1 fong1 dou1 gok3 dak1 gung1 ping4

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose idea of trading or mutually exchanging things.

example.english: We exchange phone numbers when the meeting ends.
example.traditional: 我哋散會嗰陣交換電話號碼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 saan3 wui6 go2 zan6 gaau1 wun6 din6 waa6 hou6 maa5

rows.note: Use this specifically for an organized market or institution where securities or other goods are traded.

example.english: I waited for my friend outside the exchange this morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早喺交易所門口等朋友。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hai2 gaau1 jik6 so2 mun4 hau2 dang2 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this specifically when opposing sides exchange gunfire or other weapons fire.

example.english: The two teams exchange fire on the hill.
example.jyutping: loeng5 deoi6 hai2 saan1 tau4 gaau1 fo2

rows.note: Use this when people exchange blows or engage in physical combat, rather than exchanging fire.

example.english: The two boxers finally exchange blows.
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 kyun4 sau2 zung1 jyu1 gaau1 sau2

rows.note: Use this for a conversation or back-and-forth exchange of remarks between people.

example.english: This exchange helped me understand what he was thinking better.
example.traditional: 呢段對話令我更加明白佢點諗。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 deoi3 waa6 ling6 ngo5 gang3 gaa1 ming4 baak6 keoi5 dim2 nam2
